title: こいのぼり (Koinobori — Carp Streamers)
description: The beloved Children's Day (May 5th) song about the colorful carp-shaped streamers that fly above Japanese houses. The big black carp is the father, the red carp the children, and they swim together happily in the breeze. Every Japanese child sings this in early May, and the sight of koinobori flying against the blue sky is one of the most iconic images of spring in Japan.
